subject: Marketplace private offer unit price mapping - AWS/GCP/Azure follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@brightcart.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:10:00 +0000
Subject: Recap: Marketplace private offer unit price mapping (post-demo)

Alex / Sarah — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and clear next steps so we're all aligned on how to map unit prices across AWS/GCP/Azure private offers.

Call recap:
- BrightCart expected production volumes: 100M - 300M tokens / month (you said ~200M likely in month 1 of rollout).
- Target monthly budget range you gave: approx $60k - $120k (flexible depending on committed volumes).
- Target unit-economics ask: looking for a target list price in the ballpark of $300 - $500 per 1M tokens (BrightCart preference: keep total monthly under $120k).

Marketplace mapping considerations we discussed:
- Redwood hosted unit price (base) vs. marketplace listing price (needs to include marketplace margin / fees and billing increment constraints).
- AWS/GCP/Azure each have slightly different fee stacks and listing granularity — we need to map to a single-listing unit (price per 1M tokens) for the private offer.
- Billing increments: suggest 1M-token increments for clarity in the PO.

Attachments: attached a draft price-mapping spreadsheet and PO template for review (brightcart-price-mapping-draft.xlsx, Marketplace_PO_template.pdf).

Action items / next steps:
1) Alex: confirm the final expected monthly token target (closest single number, e.g., 200M).
2) Alex: confirm whether BrightCart is comfortable with a single per-1M token list price per marketplace or prefers per-region pricing.
3) Sarah (AWS) / GCP contact: any constraints from marketplace side on private offer line-item pricing (recommended markup to cover fees, billing increments)?
4) Priyom / Aditya (internal): propose a recommended unit-price mapping for each marketplace and a suggested PO amount for the deal team.

If you can confirm (1) and (2) today, Priyom and I will push a first-draft mapping back by tomorrow morning.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — great recap. Confirming the numbers from our side:
- Closest expected steady-state: ~200M tokens / month (first 3 months we expect ramp from 120M to 220M).
- Budget: target monthly spend we aim for is $60k - $120k; would like to keep expected closer to the upper-middle of that (~$80k/month) if possible.
- Unit price guidance: BrightCart's procurement is targeting $300 - $450 per 1M tokens; we know marketplace fees will add to that so want to understand final landed price on AWS/GCP/Azure.

Two quick questions:
1) Do you have a recommended list price per 1M token on the marketplaces that gives us the $300-$450 net to BrightCart after fees?
2) For the PO, are you able to provide a single AWS private offer line (price per 1M tokens) and Redwood will handle accounting/settlement?

I'll review the attachments and get back if we have any procurement constraints. Happy to jump on a quick follow-up tomorrow if that helps.

-Alex

Subject: RE: Marketplace private offer unit price mapping - proposed numbers

Marissa / team — putting a first-pass mapping together based on the numbers Alex shared. Key assumptions: Redwood base hosted list = $350 / 1M tokens (this is the internal price we want BrightCart to effectively see). Marketplace fee estimates: AWS ~20% (including marketplace and listing margins), Azure ~21%, GCP ~17% (estimates, need confirmation from marketplace contacts). We also round to sensible SKU prices for listing.

Proposed listing prices (per 1M tokens):
- Redwood hosted (net to Redwood): $350 / 1M (target)
- AWS Marketplace listing price: $420 / 1M (covers ~20% marketplace fee -> lands ~$350 net)
- Azure Marketplace listing price: $425 / 1M (covers ~21% fee)
- GCP Marketplace listing price: $410 / 1M (covers ~17% fee)

Breakdown example at 200M tokens:
- 200 x $350 = $70,000 net to Redwood
- AWS listing: 200 x $420 = $84,000 (marketplace collects difference as fees)

Notes / recommendations:
- Offer BrightCart a committed tier with blended discounts at >=250M tokens (e.g., reduce net to Redwood to $325 / 1M and adjust listings accordingly).
- Keep billing increment at 1M tokens for the private offer line item to simplify procurement and invoicing.
- Confirm exact marketplace fee percentages with AWS/GCP contacts before finalizing PO template.

I've attached an updated mapping spreadsheet (brightcart-price-mapping-draft.xlsx) with formulas and scenarios (volume tiers, net vs list price). Priyom

--
